title: Celestial Sorceress
description: A female character with long flowing purple hair and a golden crown floats dynamically in a cosmic sky. She wears a revealing white and purple outfit with gold trim, holds a long ornate golden staff with a star emblem, and is accompanied by a small floating purple creature.
prompt: A beautiful sorceress with voluminous long purple hair styled in an elaborate updo with a golden crown floats gracefully against a vibrant cosmic nebula background filled with stars and glowing clouds. She wears a form-fitting white and purple dress with gold accents and thigh-high boots, dynamically posing while holding a long golden staff topped with a star. A small purple magical creature floats beside her. Dramatic lighting, sparkling particles, ethereal ribbons flowing around her.
